title: Midnight Injera with Spicy Ethiopian Molten Bisque
description: A warm, comforting Ethiopian-inspired meal for a late-night craving. Soft injera bread served with a spicy, rich molten bisque.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, puree the canellini beans, red onion, ginger, garlic, cumin, paprika, and cayenne pepper (if using).
Heat the oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the bean mixture and chicken broth to the saucepan. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the bisque simmer for 10-15 minutes or until heated through.
Meanwhile, toast the injera bread in the oven for 2-3 minutes or until lightly browned.
Serve the warm molten bisque with the toasted injera bread on the side.
